description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
